headline: Has the 'Era of Major Urban Renewal' Hit a Wall? Reasons Behind the Sharp Decline in Residential Demolition Volume Revealed | ETtoday Real Estate Cloud | ETtoday News Cloud
summary: Residential demolition permits in Taiwan totaled 1,846 units in the first half, down 17.8% from a year earlier and 32.3% below the 2023 peak. The decline reflects slowing urban renewal activity.
why: Demolition and redevelopment permits are a leading indicator of construction activity and property supply, which matter to developers, construction firms and housing prices.
